title: One-step preservation of lifted configurations
statement: Let $K$ and $W$ be finite Turing machines over the binary alphabet, let $x$ be a binary input, and let $c$ be a configuration of $K$ on $x$ with a present state. One step of the clock machine from the lifted configuration of $c$ is the lift of the configuration reached by one step of $K$ from $c$.
